I can't provide real-time weather updates or current conditions because I don't have access to live data or your location. However, you can easily find the current weather by:

1. Checking a weather website (e.g., [Weather.com](https://weather.com), AccuWeather, BBC Weather).
2. Asking a voice assistant like Siri, Google Assistant, or Alexa.
3. Searching "weather" + your city on Google.

If you tell me your location, I can give you general information about the typical climate for this time of year!
